summary: - _a) Accord approval for revision in Green Contracts to align them with the RE source classification as per the RE consumption framework prescribed in the Ministry of Power Notification dated 20.10.2023 & its amendment time to time._ - _b) Accord approval to the modifications proposed in the Business Rules and contract specifications to incorporate the above RE classification._ - _c) Issue appropriate directions to NLDC to make provisions in the T-GNA procedures for issuance of appropriate standing clearance endorsing the RE category type for participation in the contracts._ 19. The Petitioner submitted that the Petition has been filed seeking approval of the Commission to revise Green Contracts at IEX to align them with the Renewable Energy 20. Considering the submission, the Commission directed as follows: (a) Admit and issue notice to the Respondent, subject to just exceptions; (b) The Respondent to file its reply, if any, within four weeks, with a copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any, within three weeks thereafter. 21. Further, considering the aspects involved in the matter, the Commission considered it appropriate to list the present matter along with Petition Nos. 277/MP/2024 and 446/MP/2025. 22. The Petitioner submitted that the Petition has been filed seeking approval of the Commission to revise the Green Contracts at IEX to align them with the Renewable Energy (RE) consumption framework as per the MoP notification dated 20.10.2023. 23. In response to the specific query of the Commission as to whether Grid India (NLDC) has filed its reply/ response to the instant Petition, Grid India replied in the negative. However, Grid India submitted that it has no objection to the prayers as made by the Petitioner. 24. Considering the submissions made by both parties, the Commission directed the Respondent, NLDC, to file its reply within two weeks, with a copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinder, if any, within two weeks thereafter. 25. The Petitioner and the Respondent were directed to clarify, on an affidavit, within two weeks, the fungibility provision contained in the notification and submit their views on possible options for incorporating this provision into Green Contracts, along with the 33. In view of the response shared above, it is prayed that the Commission may be pleased to pass such order as the Commission may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case. 34. The Petitioner, IEX, filed additional information in compliance with the RoP for the hearing dated 12.08.2025. 44. In view of the above and considering the overall development of the RE market, it is submitted that the Commission may consider the present submission and pass such orders as may be deemed fit. 45. The Petitioner submitted that in compliance with the direction of the Commission 47. Considering the submissions made by the representatives of the parties, the Commission reserved the matter for Order. - _(2) No amendment to the bye-laws, rules and business rules shall be carried out without prior approval of the Commission:_ _Provided that the Commission may, through a separate order, dispense with the requirement of prior approval for amendment of certain provisions of the byelaws, rules and business rules;_ 55. The Commission has taken note of the submissions made by Petitioner and Respondent, and the latest RCO notification issued by the MoP. The Commission observes that reclassification of Green Contracts on the Power exchanges, as per the recent notification by the MoP dated 27.09.2025 and its subsequent amendment, is required to facilitate RPO/RCO compliance by the obligated entities. Accordingly, the Commission decides that the Petitioner be allowed to make changes in Green Contracts on its platform, in accordance with the classification provided in the RCO notification dated 27.09.2025 and subsequent amendments thereto, and the Commission’s directions in the subsequent paragraphs of this order. 56. The Petitioner is directed to make suitable changes in its platform with respect to the classification criteria for Wind/Hydro/DRE/Other RE sources as per the RCO notification dated 27.09.2025. The eligibility conditions for sellers' participation in the respective sub-segments of Green Contracts shall be in line with the RCO notification and any subsequent amendments thereto. Further, the underlying market-clearing mechanism and all other functionalities shall remain unchanged. The Petitioner will issue a certificate detailing the trades undertaken by buyers in each category, which may be used by buyers to meet RE consumption targets and RPO compliance. 58. In case of portfolio sale by DISCOMS, the Petitioner is directed to include the name and source (viz. Wind/Hydro/DRE/Other RE) of RE plants in order to ensure true visibility of RE power. 61. We hereby direct the Petitioner to make appropriate changes in its software and to align its Business Rules, Rules and Bye-laws in accordance with the approval granted in this order and in line with the RE classification as per the RCO notification dated 27.09.2025 and amendment thereto. We further direct the Petitioner to submit a compliance report of the same on affidavit within two weeks after the changes by NLDC in the NOAR Portal and T- GNA procedures. The Petitioner is also directed to upload the revised Business Rules, Rules and Bye-laws on its website. Further, if any discrepancy is noticed, or it appears that the revised Business Rules, Rules and Byelaws do not conform to the Regulations and/or directions contained in this order and the RE classification as per the RCO notification dated 27.09.2025, the Commission will issue necessary directions for such compliance.
title: Petition under Section 66 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 25 and 19 of the CERC (Power Market) Regulations, 2021, for approval of the revision in Green Contracts at Indian Energy Exchange Ltd. to align them with the Renewable Energy (RE) consumption framework as per the Ministry of Power Notification dated 20.10.2023. Indian Energy Exchange Limited
